use clap::{Parser, ValueEnum};

#[derive(Parser, Debug, Clone)]
#[command(name = "pls")]
#[command(about = "pls is a prettier and powerful ls(1) for the pros.", long_about = None)]
#[command(version = "0.0.1-beta.9")]
pub struct Args {
    /// the paths to list, each of which may be a file or directory
    #[arg(value_name = "PATHS")]
    pub paths: Vec<PathBuf>,

    /// the data points to show about each node
    #[arg(short = 'd', long, value_enum, default_value = "none")]
    pub det: DetailLevel,

    /// show headers above columnar data
    #[arg(short = 'H', long, value_enum, default_value = "true")]
    pub header: BoolValue,

    /// the type of units to use for the node sizes
    #[arg(short = 'u', long, value_enum, default_value = "binary")]
    pub unit: UnitType,

    /// display node names in multiple columns
    #[arg(short = 'g', long, value_enum, default_value = "false")]
    pub grid: BoolValue,

    /// display node names column-first
    #[arg(short = 'D', long, value_enum, default_value = "false")]
    pub down: BoolValue,

    /// display icons next to node names
    #[arg(short = 'i', long, value_enum, default_value = "true")]
    pub icon: BoolValue,

    /// display node type suffixes after the node name
    #[arg(short = 'S', long, value_enum, default_value = "true")]
    pub suffix: BoolValue,

    /// show symlink targets
    #[arg(short = 'l', long, value_enum, default_value = "true")]
    pub sym: BoolValue,

    /// show dependent nodes as children of their principal nodes
    #[arg(short = 'c', long, value_enum, default_value = "true")]
    pub collapse: BoolValue,

    /// align items accounting for leading dots
    #[arg(short = 'a', long, value_enum, default_value = "true")]
    pub align: BoolValue,

    /// the set of node types to include in the output
    #[arg(short = 't', long, value_enum, default_value = "all")]
    pub typ: NodeType,

    /// the importance cutoff to dim or hide unimportant files
    #[arg(short = 'I', long, default_value = "0")]
    pub imp: i32,

    /// the pattern of files to selectively hide from the output
    #[arg(short = 'e', long)]
    pub exclude: Option<String>,

    /// the pattern of files to exclusively show in the output
    #[arg(short = 'o', long)]
    pub only: Option<String>,

    /// the set of fields to sort by, trailing `_` reverses the direction
    #[arg(short = 's', long, value_delimiter = ' ', default_values = ["cat", "cname"])]
    pub sort: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(ValueEnum, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DetailLevel {
    Dev,
    Ino,
    Nlink,
    Typ,
    Perm,
    Oct,
    User,
    Uid,
    Group,
    Gid,
    Size,
    Blocks,
    Btime,
    Ctime,
    Mtime,
    Atime,
    Git,
    None,
    Std,
    All,
}

#[derive(ValueEnum, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum BoolValue {
    #[value(name = "true")]
    True,
    #[value(name = "false")]
    False,
}

impl BoolValue {
    pub fn is_true(self) -> bool {
        self == BoolValue::True
    }
}

#[derive(ValueEnum, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum UnitType {
    Binary,
    Decimal,
    None,
}

#[derive(ValueEnum, Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum NodeType {
    Dir,
    Symlink,
    Fifo,
    Socket,
    #[value(name = "block-device")]
    BlockDevice,
    #[value(name = "char-device")]
    CharDevice,
    File,
    None,
    All,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SortField {
    Dev,
    Ino,
    Nlink,
    Typ,
    Cat,
    User,
    Uid,
    Group,
    Gid,
    Size,
    Blocks,
    Btime,
    Ctime,
    Mtime,
    Atime,
    Name,
    Cname,
    Ext,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SortSpec {
    pub field: SortField,
    pub reverse: bool,
}

pub fn parse_sort_specs(sort_strs: &[String]) -> Vec<SortSpec> {
    sort_strs
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|s| {
            let reverse = s.ends_with('_');
            let field_str = if reverse { &s[..s.len() - 1] } else { s };
            let field = match field_str {
                "dev" => SortField::Dev,
                "ino" => SortField::Ino,
                "nlink" => SortField::Nlink,
                "typ" => SortField::Typ,
                "cat" => SortField::Cat,
                "user" => SortField::User,
                "uid" => SortField::Uid,
                "group" => SortField::Group,
                "gid" => SortField::Gid,
                "size" => SortField::Size,
                "blocks" => SortField::Blocks,
                "btime" => SortField::Btime,
                "ctime" => SortField::Ctime,
                "mtime" => SortField::Mtime,
                "atime" => SortField::Atime,
                "name" => SortField::Name,
                "cname" => SortField::Cname,
                "ext" => SortField::Ext,
                "none" => return None,
                _ => return None,
            };
            Some(SortSpec { field, reverse })
        })
        .collect()
}
